info.title: SkillServe API
info.description: REST API for the SkillServe admin web system — a modular monolith (Laravel 13 + Sanctum). All responses use the standard envelope: { success, message, data, errors, meta }.

post.description: POST /api/administrators — create a new administrator account.

first_name: The first name field is required.
last_name: The last name field is required.

put.description: PUT/PATCH /api/administrators/{administrator} — update name, email, role or status.

email: An administrator with this email already exists.

example.message: You cannot deactivate your own account.

status: You cannot deactivate your own account.

get.description: GET /api/permissions — every permission grouped by module.
GET /api/roles — paginated, searchable list of roles.
GET /api/roles/{role} — a single role with its permissions.

name: A role with this name already exists.

delete.description: DELETE /api/roles/{role} — delete a role (system role protected).

422.description: System default role cannot be deleted

example.message: The system default role cannot be deleted.

role: The system default role cannot be deleted.

put.description: PUT /api/roles/{role}/permissions — sync the permission matrix for a role.

422.description: Validation error / super administrator permissions immutable

permissions.0: One or more selected permissions do not exist.

post.summary: Login and get a bearer token
post.description: POST /api/auth/login — validate credentials and issue a Sanctum token.

email: The email field must be a valid email address.

example.message: Too many login attempts. Please try again later.

post.summary: Logout and revoke the current token
post.description: POST /api/auth/logout — revoke the current session token.
POST /api/auth/change-password — verify the current password and store a new one.

bearerAuth.description: Paste the Sanctum token returned by POST /api/auth/login.
